title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-09-06
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard (No Dolby) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Solid sound‑board recording that captures a raw 1969 set with highlights like Big Boy Pete and an exploratory He Was A Friend Of Mine, but the overall performance feels uneven.
ai_review.review: The tape is a soundboard source with generally good clarity; early tracks suffer from low volume and tape hiss while later songs (especially Big Boy Pete) are well‑mixed and punchy. Musically the show is mixed – Garcia’s guitar tone is praised and several numbers such as Good Lovin’, He Was A Friend Of Mine, and All Over Now get strong fan love, yet one reviewer felt the band merely “walked through” the set with little musicality.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars noting strong moments and decent soundboard quality, but a few low‑rating comments about sluggish playing pull the average down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall with a solid mix on later tracks; first three tracks are low in volume and have tape hiss, but no major dropouts or distortion reported.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual for ’69 with Jerry on lead vocal for Good Lovin', a long exploratory He Was A Friend Of Mine, and rare inclusion of All Over Now; overall pacing described as raw and at times sluggish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is described as rock‑solid and strong; he leads vocals on Good Lovin' and joins the jam with Jefferson Airplane.
